title: config/owner.yml
description: The owner's preferences (PRD FR-41): the teams they follow, the services they have and what they like to watch. The e-mail address and credentials are never here; they are GitHub Secrets.

teams.description: Team ids from data/teams.yml, most important first. Their matches come first in the daily e-mail.

services.description: Service ids from data/rights/services.yml. A match is watchable when it is free or one of these includes its broadcaster.

notable_competitions.description: Competition ids from config/competitions.yml whose big matches are worth listing even when none of the teams plays.

preferred_broadcasters.description: Broadcaster ids the owner likes best, most liked first. A match on one of them is shown first among its broadcasters.

preferred_kinds.description: Kinds of broadcaster the owner likes best.
